title: Kratom use disorder among people who use kratom: data and code
description: Records, decisions, extracted data and analysis code for a registered systematic review and meta-analysis of the prevalence of kratom use disorder and dependence among people who use kratom (search 21 November 2026; 14 studies, 14 samples, 6,859 people who use kratom). The repository includes the protocol and deviations log, search logs and records, two AI screening passes with the reviewer's blind calibration and decisions, AI full-text proposals with the reviewer's decisions, AI extraction drafts with the reviewer's verification, the analysis tables, R and Python analysis scripts, results, figures, Tables 1-4 and Supplementary Files S1-S9.
